title: MUTANT: A Multi-sentential Code-mixed Hinglish Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a multi-sentential code-mixed Hinglish dataset and a pipeline for its identification, along with evaluating different threshold generalization techniques. It does not contain a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The mention of 'biases' in the limitations refers to topical/style biases in data sources, not ethical or faith-related biases in models or data.
